summary.text: A fragment of immemorial green heaven that houses Sacred Feather City and a long-isolated featherman settlement with Late Antiquity Era methods.

claims.text: The sky is green, and wind that will not stop in all four seasons blows gently. A pure white and vast city floats stably in the air, letting out faint golden radiance. Sacred Feather City is that headquarters. Invaders later tear a huge crack in the green sky above the city.
Zheng Ling compares another small world as inferior to the green heaven fragment world yet enough for his tribe to live.

The green heaven fragment world was isolated from the outside world for a long time; Sacred Feather City is a paradise for feathermen and a huge settlement among those remaining. With few outside interactions and plenty of resources, these featherman Gu Immortals’ methods are quaint and carry Late Antiquity Era characteristics.

From Zheng Ling’s soul Fang Yuan gains precious information regarding Immortal Gu House Sacred Feather City and the green heaven fragment world the feathermen lived in. The world is huge and rich in resources. He knows the scenery well enough to use Fixed Immortal Travel, but White Sea Shatuo and other Gu Immortals occupy it, so he will not risk entering lightly.

In a green heaven fragment world within Western Desert, that fragment is the paradise for a group of feathermen, and Immortal Gu House Sacred Feather City is their strongest headquarters. White Sea Shatuo leads Western Desert Gu Immortals who invade through a crack in the green sky, immobilize Sacred Feather City, and besiege it for days. When a wall of the Immortal Gu House crumbles, dust clouds rise and a slight trace of green light flashes from within.

Sacred Feather City can absorb the power of wishes from past and present generations of feathermen in the city to automatically refine wish power mortal Gu. Generations of feathermen lived in the immemorial green heaven fragment world; even after the immortal killer move heavenly wish already expends a large number of the stored wish power mortal Gu, more than half remain. Shadow Sect later activates those wish power Gu without counting the cost, and the power of wishes strengthens Sacred Feather City in all aspects.

In Spectral Soul’s memory scenes, an abundance of green light marks a green heaven fragment world of the immemorial nine heavens, where human Gu Masters fight featherman Gu Immortals and Sacred Feather City is thrown out.
